purpose: A reusable full-height room-divider system at all seven plate seams, with permanent mirrored steel housings, separately retracting pressure membranes, continuous tunnel floors, foreground concrete occlusion, and reversible close-after-crossing behavior.

generation.prompt_summary: Original 16-bit side-scroller atmosphere lock viewed edge-on: a tall narrow housing mounted on the right wall, approached horizontally from the left, with a convex pale energy seal projecting left. Flat #ff00ff chroma background, no front-facing arch, no typography, no logos, and no floor.
generation.wall_prompt_summary: One continuous load-bearing concrete-and-steel divider spine on flat #ff00ff, front-orthographic and solid from top to bottom, with straight edges and no door or opening. Runtime repeats it at seven seams and places mirrored portal faces against both wall surfaces.
generation.housing_prompt_summary: Precise-object edit of the approved side-profile lock: remove only the white projected membrane, preserve the dark steel housing, rail, clamps, brackets, pixel clusters, proportions, and side-on orientation, and replace the removed field with flat #ff00ff chroma.
generation.membrane_prompt_summary: Precise-object edit of the approved side-profile lock: isolate only the pale translucent convex pressure membrane, remove every metal housing component, preserve the SNES-era pixel steps and highlights, and place the field on flat #ff00ff chroma.
generation.rejected_direction: A front-facing rectangular arch was rejected because it contradicted the side-on approach.

runtime.palette: 64-color quantized RGB with soft alpha edge

housing_runtime.placement: 54×206 crop at x=26 on a transparent 80×206 canvas

membrane_runtime.placement: 58×166 crop at x=0, y=20 on a transparent 80×206 canvas
membrane_runtime.behavior: Retracts horizontally into the housing on approach and reforms after Aryn clears the opposite housing.

seam_wall.palette: 64-color quantized RGB with soft alpha edge

placement.door_y: deckTop + 24 - 206, except Biolab → Uplink applies a -24 visual offset
placement.door_floor_bottom_y: deckTop + 24, except Biolab → Uplink lands at deckTop
placement.player_occlusion: The wall sprite is redrawn full-height after Aryn, hiding her while she crosses the enclosed divider at any of the seven deck heights.

states.offline: The projected seal is tinted red and remains solid.
states.standby: Ordinary unlocked passages use cyan seals and open automatically in 0.58 seconds on approach.
states.ready: An objective-locked seal turns green after its associated Foundry or Biolab atmospheric stabilizer is restored.
states.opening: Near-player approach retracts both opposed membranes horizontally into their fixed wall-face housings; objective locks retain the deliberate 1.25-second opening beat.
states.open: The paired housings remain on the two wall faces. A continuous collision floor carries Aryn through the solid concrete divider while its foreground layer hides her until she emerges.
states.closing: After Aryn crosses and her complete collision body clears the opposite housing, both membranes reform over 0.50 seconds for ordinary passages or 0.78 seconds for objective locks. Returning toward a closing lock reverses it safely.
states.rearm: A completed close remains latched while Aryn is still inside the proximity radius. It rearms only after she leaves that radius or deliberately moves back toward the door, preventing a close-open-close exit loop.
